g.text: Per model: 68 accounts x 40 tasks x 3 request types x 4 runs = 32,640 runs. Confirmatory: Claude Haiku 5.5, GPT-6 Luna. Exploratory: Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite, OLMo 3 7B.
